Gym models ? CC BY 4.0
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Models are scaled/placed for VITAL VR. Encoded source images were extracted without pixel modification into shared SHA256/channel files. GLB geometry, material parameters, UVs and normals were retained; Unity imports textures at <=1024 with mipmaps, ASTC 6x6 on Android. Original and derived hashes are in Assets/ThirdParty/GymModels/sources.json. Reproduce: python tools/Externalize-GymTextures.py.
